rows.en:
(Nanase and Ranka were around here...
Where on earth did they go?)

\p-kun,
over here!

Ranka, I was looking for you.
Where'd you go?
Wait, and you're out of uniform...

Yes, Nana-chan asked me to model for her painting.
And that made me think
maybe I'd try drawing, too.
Huh, that's great. What are you gonna draw?

Ehehe... About that,
I have a little favor to ask...
...Why do I have to be the model...?

I'll treat you to Galaxy Ramen at Nyan-Nyan,
okay?
rows.notes: Male, Ranka; Galaxy Ramen as in c02326.

rows.en: Well, if that's the deal, I guess it's fine...

Okay, I'm going to keep drawing,
so please don't move.

(Nanase and Ranka-chan should be around here...
Where on earth did they go?)

\p-cha~n,
over here!

Ranka-chan, I was looking for you~
Where'd you go?
Huh, that's great. What are you going to draw?
...Wh-why do I have to be the model...?

\p-chan, you're so cute,
you're really worth drawing.
D-don't say weird stuff like that!
(Ranka called me to the art room, but...)
S-sorry... It was kind of short notice.

Come on, come on,
hurry up and get in the art room!
...Is this... again?

I'll treat you to Galaxy Ramen at Nyan-Nyan
again today, okay?

(I'm worn out, but today was
another nice change of pace.)
(Ranka-chan called me to the art room, but...)

Sorry, a teacher called me in...
So, what did you need?

Geez~ Don't make that face!
Smile, smile!
Ha, hahaha...

(I'm worn out, but today was
another nice change of pace~)
(Today I'm going out to have fun with Ranka.)
Nah, I just got here myself.
rows.notes: Male; answers Ranka's 'sorry to keep you waiting' (c13152).

rows.en:
Oh, good~!
So, where should we start looking around?

Let's see...
Mind if we stop by the department store?
We both bought a lot of stuff, huh...

I just got paid for my part-time job,
so I might've gotten a little carried away...

Ahaha... I'll have to skimp on lunch
for a while, too.
Well then, shall we head home for today?

(Today I'm going out to have fun
with Ranka-chan.)
Nope, I just got here, too.

Let's see...
I kind of want to go to the department store.
Ahaha... We bought a lot of stuff, huh.
I'll be skimping on lunch for a while~
(Today I'm going shopping with Ranka.)

"You're late!" ...is what I'd say,
but I just got here myself.
Geez! For a second I thought you were serious!

Ahaha, sorry, sorry.
Well then, let's go look around.
We bought a ton again today, huh.
Ugh, so much for learning from last time...
rows.notes: x2, Ranka; zenkai no hansei ga.

rows.en: Ahaha... Now I'm gonna have to skip lunch...
(Today I came shopping with Ranka-chan.)

"You're late!" ...is what I'd say,
but I just got here, too.

Sorry, sorry.
Well then, let's go look around!
We bought a ton again today, huh.
Ahaha... I might even have to skip lunch...
(What should I do now?)
\p-kun, heading home?
You showed up at just the right time, Ranka!

If you want, why don't we
stop by Silver Moon?
Haah, this is so relaxing~

You sound like an old man~
You're young, so perk up a little...

Give me a break.
I just got out of a tiring class.
Geez, you're hopeless...
rows.notes: x2, Ranka; shou ga nai naa (fond).

rows.en:
Come on, let's have a little fun
before we head home!
\p-chan, heading home?

You showed up at just the right time,
Ranka-chan!

You sound like a little old granny~
You're young, so perk up a little...

Oh, come on.
I just got out of a tiring class.
(What should I do now...?)

Hey, Ranka!
Fancy running into you here.

Since we ran into each other,
wanna stop somewhere on the way home?
Yeah, sure! Let's go, let's go!!
We ended up at Silver Moon after all, huh.

It's the go-to spot at Mihoshi.
Everyone comes here.

Maybe next time we could scout out
a new go-to spot.

Why wait for next time?
Let's go look for one right now!
Huh, seriously?!

Oh, Ranka-cha~n!
Fancy running into you here.

Hey, hey, since we ran into each other,
wanna stop somewhere on the way home?
We ended up at Silver Moon after all, huh.

Maybe next time we could discover
a new place?
